question: You are a program manager as agent for an owner in the oil and gas industry. The program has two projects: Project A and Project B. Project A has very clear requirements, but the owner must minimize the risk of any disputes. Project B must follow a low-bid contractor selection process and needs to be fast-tracked. You recommend:

choices.B: Multiple-prime contracting for Project A; design-bid-build for Project B.
choices.C: Integrated Project Delivery for Project A; design-build for Project B.
choices.D: Design-build for Project A; multiple-prime contracting for Project B.
